--- set_operator_mixed_propagation.sql
GRAPH FinGraph
RETURN 1 AS id
FULL UNION ALL
RETURN 2 AS id
UNION ALL
RETURN 3 AS id

--- AST

          NameEnd: 14,

  },
  Query: &ast.GQLMultiLinearQueryStatement{
    Statements: []ast.GQLLinearQueryStatement{

            },

        Operations: []*ast.GQLSetOperation{
          &ast.GQLSetOperation{
            ColumnPropagationModePos: 30,

            AllOrDistinct:            "ALL",
            Right:                    &ast.GQLSimpleLinearQueryStatement{
              Statements: []ast.GQLPrimitiveQueryStatement{
                &ast.GQLReturn{
                  Return: 45,

                      Star: -1,

                        ValuePos: 52,

                        As:    54,
                        Alias: &ast.Ident{
                          NamePos: 57,
                          NameEnd: 59,
                          Name:    "id",
                        },
                      },
                    },
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
          &ast.GQLSetOperation{
            ColumnPropagationModePos: -1,
            OpPos:                    60,
            Op:                       "UNION",
            AllOrDistinct:            "ALL",
            Right:                    &ast.GQLSimpleLinearQueryStatement{
              Statements: []ast.GQLPrimitiveQueryStatement{
